about: Demo edition of a fictional meetup, built with: python3 build.py --edition examples/riverside-meetup/edition.json --out dist-riverside --serve. It shows a dark scheme, a logo, a bundled heading font, a sub-folder address, the offline copy, a second language edition in the header and the optional directory page. Nothing in it is real: the sites are example.org addresses.

book.title: A Guide to Autonomy
intro: The book we read together on Tuesday evenings at the Riverside meetup: privacy, digital autonomy and money, one chapter at a time.
Each chapter starts from a concrete need, explains why a tool helps and where it falls short, then walks you through the steps, with sources close to the passages they support.
